newsitem.title: INDIA: India's BHEL up three pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India's BHEL up three pct on results.

text.p: Shares of equipment maker Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd (BHEL) climbed 11.25 rupees, or 3.2 percent, to 368.50 on Monday in early trade on the Bombay bourse, dealers said.
They said there were buyers in the share after the firm announced sharply improved results for 1996/97 (April-March) last week.
State-run BHEL said last Thursday its net profit surged nearly 34 percent to 4.68 billion rupees ($130 million), from 3.5 billion in 1995/96.
Analysts said the results beat all market expectations with the average consensus net profit forecast pegged as low as 3.8 billion rupees.
The company said its turnover during 1996/97 jumped to 57.40 billion rupees from 48.33 billion a year earlier.
BHEL shares have vaulted nearly 12 percent since the results announcement.
